Rule re-decoded + simplified (verified 500 + 2000 fresh ARC-GEN samples): **per row, per color c, fill columns from the leftmost to the rightmost marker of color c.** (The chevron geometry guarantees exactly 2 markers per color per row except the flat 2-wide apex row.) Per-color fill masks have matrix **rank 2-4** (data-dependent triangles, diagonal-bounded `c-r>=k1 ∧ c+r<=k2`) — rank kill test on 2000 samples.

FORCED charged tensors (cross-formulation floor for the data + color recovery):
- `y_full_u8 [1,1,30,30]` U8 = **900 B** RESISTS. The mask is genuinely 2-D (rank 2-4, non-separable diagonals), so no rank-≤2 free-output final (broadcast-Add, BitwiseAnd, broadcast-Greater) can express it (those emit only axis-aligned rectangles / row-set∩col-set). The active region is **10×10 = 100 cells > the 90-cell #81 one-hot-inversion crossover**, so emitting a `[1,10,10,10]` one-hot + free Pad costs 1000 B and LOSES to the 900 B canvas by 100. #109 separable-Einsum needs input-derived per-row interval endpoints whose F32-locked 30-extent selectors price ≥~1900 B.

The per-cell color index is a channel-weighted collapse of the F32 one-hot = a 1×1 negpad Conv; Conv output dtype is locked to the F32 input dtype (F16 conv needs an 18 KB F16 input plane — the prompt's known don't-do). ArgMax(axis=1) alternative is `[1,30,30]` (worse). U8/Slice collapse needs a `[1,10,10,10]` = 1000 B slice (worse).

Forced floor = 900 + 400 = **1300 B**. The remaining 1777−1300 = 477 B is toggle/assembly machinery: `colors` 100 (Cast→U8, forced for BitwiseXor) + `y_u8` 100 (Concat) + ~250 column tensors + 27 params. Every restructuring priced is ≥ current: full-plane log-doubling prefix-XOR = 4 planes × 100 = 400 > the 250 column cascade; nearest-left/right MaxPool packing = v7's 2552; F16 color plane needs the 18 KB input cast. ## Rule

Per row, fill each same-color horizontal marker pair. The live graph implements this generically per color: for each non-background color `c`, mark cells whose row has a `c` at or to the left and a `c` at or to the right, then make channel 0 the complement.

Corpus contract checked on `corpus.build(41, want=200000)`: input/output shapes are fixed 10x10. Every row has 0, 2, or 4 non-background markers. Four-marker rows always form two same-color adjacent pairs in left-to-right order, and the first/last marker colors never match. This justifies the staged TopK two-span renderer.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
out = zeros_like(inp)
for r in range(10):
    cols = [c for c in range(10) if inp[r][c] != 0]
    for right, left in zip(cols[::-1][0::2], cols[::-1][1::2]):
        color = inp[r][right]
        if color and color == inp[r][left]:
            out[r][left:right + 1] = color
```

The current staged ONNX does this statically without `TopK`: collapse the 10-channel one-hot input to a 10x10 color-index plane with a negative-pad 1x1 `Conv`, build UINT8 packed marker scores, use prefix/suffix `MaxPool` to recover the nearest left/right marker colors for each cell, keep cells only when those colors match, render one encoded color plane with `Where`, pad it to 30x30 with sentinel 10, then expand to one-hot via final `Equal(channel_ids)`.

## Cost analysis

LIVE cost is 16,327 = memory 16,300 + params 27. The dominant tensors are the generic per-color scanline planes: `Slice [1,9,10,10] F32` 3,600, two F32 `CumSum` planes 7,200 total, two bool cast planes 1,800, plus 10-channel assembly.

v1 cost is 9,203 = memory 9,140 + params 63. It removes both F32 CumSum planes and replaces them with row-level `TopK(k=4)` plus two 1-channel span masks, but still pays `nz_ch_f [1,9,10,10] F32` = 3,600.

v2 cost is 4,894 = memory 4,840 + params 54. The key win is §41 negative-pad Conv: one 1x1 Conv with pads `[0,0,-20,-20]` collapses the 10-channel input to a 10x10 color-index plane in one 400-byte output, deleting the 3,600-byte channel slice. v2 keeps pair-present and pair-color-equality gates as an OOD-conservative sibling.

v5 cost is 3,556 = memory 3,500 + params 56. It relies on the full-corpus row-pair invariant, removes the malformed-pair gates, reads only the two endpoint colors actually used, renders a 10x10 UINT8 label canvas, pads that single-channel label to 30x30 with sentinel 10, and makes the final `Equal(label, channel_ids)` the graph output. Largest remaining costs: `encoded30_u8` 900, `color_idx_f` 400, `score_f` 400, `top_idx_i` 320, mandatory `top_vals_f` 160. `polish_candidate.py` was a no-op on v5.

v7 cost is 2,552 = memory 2,500 + params 52 under `ng_gate`/`_score_v2` (standalone `cost_predictor.py` undercounts four scalar params and reports 2,548). It eliminates `TopK` by packing `16*position + color` into UINT8 marker scores. A prefix `MaxPool` gives the nearest left marker, a suffix `MaxPool` gives the nearest right marker, `Mod(16)` recovers both colors, and `Equal(left_color, right_color)` is the span gate. This removes the `TopK` values/indices, split, gather, and explicit between masks, but adds two score-build paths and two `Mod` outputs. `polish_candidate.py` was a no-op on v7.

v13 cost is 2,548 = memory 2,500 + params 48. It keeps the v7 tensor surface but removes four initializer elements: `Greater(color_idx_f, zero_f)` becomes `Cast(color_idx_f -> BOOL)`, the U8 zero false branches become `color_idx_u8` on official background/gap cells where that tensor is already zero, and the final Pad uses opset-18 `axes=[2,3]` with pads `[0,0,20,20]` instead of the full 8-value pads tensor. Refreshed team source before staging: `K-NeuroGolf-OnnxlyFans/Team_Submission/Backend/manifest.csv` row `task041,Boladi,87e099...,2552,17.1554,2026-06-08T23:23:49Z` and `NG_OnnxlyFans_TaskStatus.xlsx` `Tasks!43` agree at cost 2,552. Expected raw delta is `ln(2552/2548)=0.0015686`, so this is additive-stack material rather than a meaningful standalone submit.

v7 advisory adversarial is stronger than v5: base 266/266, color_swap 271/271, color_permutation 388/388, rotate 798/798, flip 532/532, shift 1064/1064, shrink_grid 1064/1064, empty_quadrant 1064/1064; add_isolated_cell remains imperfect at 453/497 because isolated singleton rows are outside the paired-marker live contract.

Sub-2k was not reached. The hard pressure is now: final full-output label canvas `encoded30_u8` = 900, color-index crop `color_idx_f` = 400, and twelve 10x10 UINT8/BOOL scan tensors = 1,200. The 1,640-cost crop-output probe removed the 900-byte label pad but failed visible 0/266, confirming the full 30x30 output contract. The v9/v10 dynamic-pad probes looked like 1,712 in the standalone predictor and were behavior-clean on real inputs, but `_score_v2` returned `None`; local official scoring requires static-compatible output shapes, so this is not a valid cost cut. A materially lower exact route must either compute the scan in about half as many 10x10 tensors or find a new final-output factorization that does not require a row-column canvas; control-flow (`Loop`/`Scan`) is banned by `Onnx_Advanced/00_COMPETITION_SPEC.md`.

## Don't-do log

- Do not retry the 2026-05-20 F16/cast-placement family (`whole_f16`, cast-after-slice/input-consumers/conv, drop-final-cast): previous pass found no valid cost win.
- Do not crop below 10x10 or remove the final 30x30 `Pad`: official output comparison is against the 30x30 one-hot encoding, while the corpus contract only proves active grids are fixed 10x10.
- Specifically, do not retry `build_task041_v8_u8_maxpool_crop_probe.py`: it scores 1,640 locally but fails visible 0/266 because `[1,10,10,10]` output shape is not accepted.
- Do not retry dynamic final `Pad` output extents as a scoring shortcut. `v9` and `v10` pass real-input behavior gates but `_score_v2` returns `None`; forcing static metadata does not help when the scorer dummy run produces a 10x10 actual tensor.
- Do not retry Pad-2/Pad-10 attribute pads for the U8 label canvas: schema only allows float tensors there, and U8 `MaxPool` needs opset >=12. Use opset-18 Pad axes if shrinking pad params.
- Do not retry UINT8/INT8 `TopK` for a lower-cost row-level selector. ORT CPU rejects sub-F16 `TopK`; F16 TopK plus U8-wrap intervals can improve v5 slightly but remains above v7.
- Do not retry strict-left `MaxPool` with a negative right pad to classify opening/closing markers. Shape inference may pass, but ORT load rejects the pool attributes (`Pad should be smaller than kernel`).
- Do not replace the final sentinel label canvas with a `ScatterElements(input, ...)` output base unless the index/update cost is re-priced first. Clearing channel 0 and writing the fill channel needs a two-lane F32 update/index assembly that exceeds the 900-byte label canvas.
- Do not use the TopK two-span rewrite unless the row-pair invariant remains true on the full corpus; it depends on rows having at most four markers paired right-to-left by color.
- Do not replace v5 with a gate-free variant unless it is full-corpus byte-equal. v5 specifically relies on: row marker count in {0,2,4}; four-marker rows are two same-color pairs; no first/last same-color four-marker rows.
- Do not expect `polish_candidate.py` to trim v5: on 2026-06-06 it reported no-op for onnxsim, safe_opt, const_to_init, clip_mul_to_min, scalar_broadcast_ones, and slice_axis_collapse.
- Do not expect `polish_candidate.py` to trim v13 either: on 2026-06-11 it reported no-op for the same pass family at cost 2,548.
- Do not retry control-flow (`Loop`, `Scan`, `If`/subgraph) for the row automaton; the competition spec rejects `Loop`/`Scan` and any `GRAPH`/`GRAPHS` attribute.
